memory: Radius fixed at 0.3331 mm. Higher Ra reduces real contact fraction, increases patch count, perimeter and pressure heterogeneity. 20,000 fps synchronized to pressure maps shows micro-slips initiate at hotspot edges (pressure-gradient maxima) not at pressure peaks (edge ρ≈0.72 vs center ρ≈0.24). Onset strain concentrates ≈0.6 ms before visible slip. I retract the 'hotspot center origin' hypothesis and update the mechanism toward gradient-driven micro-slip initiation. Causality across Ra and normal load untested; next protocol will vary Ra and N systematically and quantify whether edge-localization persists or shifts with patch geometry.
